Weapon_STR_Description:
A material for weapon transformation.

Grants Strength bonus.

A rare powdered metal formed from the final breath of a revenant. The breath of a brute, famed for overwhelming might, lends weapons raw, explosive power.
Weapon_DEX_Description:
A material for weapon transformation.

Grants Dexterity bonus.

A rare powdered metal formed from the final breath of a revenant. The breath of a trickster who outwitted foes with skill empowers weapons with elegant lethality.
Weapon_STRDEX_Description:
A material for weapon transformation.

Grants both Strength and Dexterity bonuses.

A rare powdered metal formed from the final breath of a revenant. The breath of one who valued balance over strength alone imparts refined mastery to any weapon.
Weapon_Fire_Description:
A material for weapon transformation.

Grants fire element.

A rare powdered metal formed from the final breath of a revenant. The breath of one who lived by passion fuels weapons with searing power.
Weapon_Ice_Description:
A material for weapon transformation.

Grants ice element.

A rare powdered metal formed from the final breath of a revenant. The breath of one who upheld reason empowers weapons with cold, unforgiving force.
Weapon_Lightning_Description:
A material for weapon transformation.

Grants lightning element.

A rare powdered metal formed from the final breath of a revenant. The breath of one who had surrendered themselves to flashes of inspiration grants weapons with piercing, thunderous force.
Weapon_Blood_Description:
A material for weapon transformation.

Grants blood element.

A rare powdered metal formed from the final breath of a revenant. Those who mastered their golden blood bestow weapons with merciless, blood-driven power.
Weapon_Venom_Description:
A material for weapon transformation.

Grants venom status ailment.

A rare powdered metal formed from the final breath of a revenant. Saturated with cursed malice, this breath grants weapons the power to cling like a serpent's bite, relentless and cruel.
Weapon_Sun_Description:
A material for weapon transformation.

Grants sunblight status ailment.

A rare powdered metal formed from the final breath of a revenant. Scorched by sunlight, this breath radiates blinding, searing brilliance and grants weapons the ability to scorch.
Weapon_Bleeding_Description:
A material for weapon transformation.

Increases enemy blood loss.

A rare powdered metal formed from the final breath of a revenant. This breath, born of pleasure in bloodshed, lends weapons the power to carve deeper, bloodier wounds.
Weapon_LoadDown_Description:
A material for weapon transformation.

Reduces burden at the cost of attack power. A legacy of Frantz, designed for versatile application.

A rare powdered metal formed from the final breath of a revenant. The breath of a courageous revenant who stood against the mighty inspires weapons that embolden the powerless. A new material co-developed across the bounds of time by Frantz Bathory and Noah G. MagMell.

Defensive_Fire_Description:
A material for defensive forma transformation.

Grants resistance against fire-element damage.

A rare leaf-shaped metallic material formed when a revenant perishes in flames, said to be the ashen remains of their final words to a loved one. Their dying prayer lends fire-resistant properties to defensive formae.
Defensive_Ice_Description:
A material for defensive forma transformation.

Grants resistance against ice-element damage.

A rare leaf-shaped metallic material formed when a revenant freezes to death, said to be the ashen remains of their final words to a loved one. That cold farewell infuses defensive formae with the strength to endure bitter frost.

A material for defensive forma transformation.

Grants resistance against lightning-element damage.

A rare leaf-shaped metallic material formed when a revenant dies from electrocution, said to be the ashen remains of their final words to a loved one. Their final prayer grants defensive formae resistance to the lightning element.

A rare leaf-shaped metallic material formed when a revenant dies, said to be the ashen remains of their final words to a loved one. The prayers of a revenant shattered in blood grant defensive formae the power to resist bloodborne interference.

Defensive_LoadDown_Description:
A material for defensive forma transformation.

Reduces burden at the cost of defense. A legacy of Frantz, designed for versatile application.

A rare leaf-shaped metallic material formed from the final breath of a fallen revenant, said to be the ashen remains of their final words to a loved one. Those words, filled with courage in the face of overwhelming power, inspire defensive formae that empower the weak. A new material co-developed across the bounds of time by Frantz Bathory and Noah G. MagMell.
Defensive_Disease_Description:
A material for defensive forma transformation.

Enhances disease resistance at the cost of increased burden.

A rare leaf-shaped metallic material left behind by a revenant who succumbs to illness, said to be the ashen remains of their final words to a loved one. Their dying words lend defensive formae the strength to resist disease-type ailments.
Defensive_Wound_Description:

Enhances wound resistance at the cost of increased burden.

Defensive_Bleed_Description:

Enhances bleed resistance at the cost of increased burden.

A rare leaf-shaped metallic material formed when a revenant perishes due to blood disruption, said to be the ashen remains of their final words to a loved one. Their final words strengthen resistance against blood-type effects.
Defensive_Curse_Description:
A material for defensive forma transformation.

Enhances curse resistance at the cost of increased burden.

A rare leaf-shaped metallic material formed when a revenant dies from a curse, said to be the ashen remains of their final words to a loved one. Their last prayer offers defensive formae resistance against curse-type effects.
Defensive_Balance_Description:
A material for defensive forma transformation.

Boosts defense at the cost of increased burden.

A rare leaf-shaped metallic material formed when a revenant dies, said to be the ashen remains of their final words to a loved one. Infused with a desperate desire to protect their kin, the words bolster the durability of defensive formae.
